question: _________ is a form of matter in which many of the electrons wander around freely among the nuclei of the atoms.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Plasma**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Plasma is the state of matter in which electrons move freely among the nuclei of atoms
 
• Plasma is a hot, ionized gas that contains electrons, ions, and neutral atoms.
 
• It's sometimes called the "fourth state of matter" because it's distinct from solids, liquids, and gases.
 
• Plasma is created by heating a gas
 
• Plasma is made up of roughly equal numbers of positively and negatively charged particles.
 
• Plasma can generate large amounts of energy.
 
• Fusion is a process that uses plasma to create energy by combining light elements like hydrogen.
